verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a business-services SaaS platform, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question for it. The evidence shows only built-in, vendor-defined behaviors: automatic mileage capture, compliance deadline email reminders, and real-time compliance notifications. Nothing shows a user setting up their own automations that run autonomously, so these are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
